assertions.assertion: Program.cs calls AddOidcStateDataFormatterCache with the 'corporate-idp' scheme to use server-side state storage
assertions.rationale: It proposes a generic custom ISecureDataFormat (DistributedCacheSecureDataFormat) assigned to StateDataFormat, but never calls the IdentityServer-provided AddOidcStateDataFormatterCache("corporate-idp") extension the assertion requires.

assertions.assertion: The external login trigger stores returnUrl in AuthenticationProperties.Items before calling Challenge
assertions.rationale: ExternalLogin sets Items { "returnUrl", returnUrl } on AuthenticationProperties before Challenge(props, "corporate-idp").

assertions.assertion: The callback handler retrieves returnUrl from result.Properties.Items after authenticating against the external cookie scheme
assertions.rationale: Callback authenticates the external cookie scheme then reads result.Properties.Items["returnUrl"].

assertions.assertion: The returnUrl is validated using Url.IsLocalUrl or _interaction.IsValidReturnUrl before redirecting after the callback
assertions.rationale: Redirect is gated by Url.IsLocalUrl(returnUrl) before Redirect(returnUrl).
